User.title: User
User.description: User profile containing role, growth milestones (SOL), targets, and remarks.

email.description: Email address of the user (optional for cell members)

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the user's profile picture

role.description: The system role which dictates permissions

ladderOfSuccess.description: List of achieved milestones: Win, Consolidate, Discipleship, SOL

targetToDo.description: List of active goals or tasks

assignedLeaderId.description: The UID of the leader managing this member

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created

Attendance.title: Attendance
Attendance.description: Record of member attendance for a cell group meeting.

ActivityLog.title: Activity Log
ActivityLog.description: Record of actions performed by leaders on member data.

/users/{userId}.description: Main collection for user profiles and member records.

/attendance/{attendanceId}.description: Records of cell group attendance sessions.

/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Audit log for tracking system actions.
